summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of MyVault (PIN vault app). Backend: 8/8 pytest tests pass (auth status/unlock/wrong-pin/brute-force-lockout/protected endpoints + full CRUD for credentials with Fernet encryption at rest verified + full CRUD for insurance). Frontend: All UI flows tested end-to-end via Playwright (PIN wrong+correct, add/search/filter/toggle/copy/edit/delete credential, insurance add with INR formatting verified, delete, tab switching, lock button). No functional issues found.

design_issues.screen: Add/Edit dialogs (Credentials & Insurance) and Delete AlertDialogs
issues: A11y warning: Radix DialogContent is missing a Description or aria-describedby attribute (console warning on every dialog open). Non-blocking but should be fixed by adding <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby={undefined-suppressor}.

action_items: (Optional a11y) Add DialogDescription to Credential/Insurance/AlertDialog components to silence Radix aria-describedby warnings.

(Note) Insurance delete-confirm test id is 'confirm-delete-insurance' while credentials use 'confirm-delete-button'. Spec mentioned only 'confirm-delete-button' — current code is intentional (unique testids). Consider standardising in docs.
critical_code_review_comments: Fernet encryption verified: MongoDB shows 'gAAAA...' encrypted password strings; API returns decrypted plaintext to authenticated clients — correct.
PIN uses bcrypt hashing (correct) and JWT (HS256, 12h expiry) — solid.
Brute-force lockout after 5 wrong attempts (429, 15 min) works correctly.
MongoDB _id properly excluded via projection {_id: 0} in list endpoints.

update_credential returns 'plain_password' from update payload but merges 'existing' doc with 'update' (which contains encrypted password), then overwrites with plaintext — correct but a bit fragile; consider explicitly returning a rebuilt Credential model.
Backend uses os.environ['MONGO_URL'] fail-fast (good) and no hardcoded URLs/credentials.
All interactive elements have data-testid attributes (excellent testability).
seed_data_creation: Test-only data created & cleaned up: TEST_* prefixed credentials and TEST_LIC insurance policy were created during tests and then removed from Mongo. login_attempts collection also cleared.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend runs at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (see /app/frontend/.env). Master PIN is 1234; if lockout occurs run: mongosh test_database --eval 'db.login_attempts.deleteMany({})'. Backend tests are in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — must be run with '-n 0' (no xdist parallelism) because the brute-force lockout test can race with the clear_lockout autouse fixture of other workers. All CRUD endpoints verified. Frontend has proper data-testid coverage.
